scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: if [ -x backend/.venv/bin/python ]; then backend/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8080; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8080; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --port 8080; else echo 'Python 3.11+ is required; create backend/.venv as described in README.md.' >&2; exit 1; fi
